One path only, asymmetrical and gently irregular; no constellation diagram or geometric network. Three humble fires begin to make the immense world habitable, not a single sacred bonfire.

No cloud or rain shower, no landscape or horizon. Seed is dry and whole; future tree exists ONLY as shadow. Seed, impending drop and connected tree-shaped shadow occupy the central half of square with generous quiet margins. Minimal, contemplative, physical and mysterious.
